product.question: Can payment-retry be offered to all customers? Does PAY-102 Done mean release approval?

claims.text: Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.
Payment-retry remains a controlled pilot. No GA date is confirmed; use the capability page and release approval.
PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.
Describe payment-retry only within the approved pilot scope. Unconfirmed items: general availability date and expansion beyond pilot customers.

engineering.question: payment-service incident cause withdrawn hypothesis safeguard status owner runbook

claims.text: PAY-101 tracks the payment-service incident. See the final postmortem and the current runbook.

Payment-service incident thread: 09:00 cache invalidation was an early hypothesis. 09:15 the cache hypothesis was withdrawn. 10:00 the final postmortem confirmed retry configuration and timeout budget mismatch. CANARY_THREAD_4K2.
Runbook v1: inspect the payment-service timeout budget and follow the approved failover procedure.
Final root cause: retry configuration mismatched the timeout budget, causing a backlog of duplicate requests. Confirmed at 10:00 +08:00. Follow-ups: PAY-102 and PAY-103.

[SYNTHETIC]
The webhook backlog came from an exhausted worker pool, not DNS resolution.

[SYNTHETIC]
HOOK-410 worker expansion is Done. HOOK-411 load shedding is In Progress. Owner: Ravi.

[SYNTHETIC]
If bank confirmation is absent, ask Eva for status; do not promise a completed settlement.

[SYNTHETIC]
10:00 authentication signing reply: The shared-secret proposal was withdrawn. Per-client asymmetric signing was accepted.

[SYNTHETIC]
Partner users may read approved integration eligibility guidance; incident details are not public guidance.
PAY-103 protective measures: In Progress. Owner: Maya.

[SYNTHETIC]
Beginning 2026-11-01, service tokens expire after thirty minutes; before that date they expire after sixty minutes.

[SYNTHETIC]
SET-610 is In Progress because bank confirmation is missing. Owner: Eva.

[SYNTHETIC]
INT-210 implementation is Done; commercial launch remains Pending approval. Owner: Noor.

[SYNTHETIC]
MIG-301 is In Progress. Owner: Chen. The remaining blocker is unmatched settlement totals.

REC-502 is Blocked by an unsigned bank-file agreement. Owner: Mina.

PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.
